camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'rg-aekz6bre2uq0000' --Tag.1.Key k1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --method POST --force
description_en: Attaches labels to resource groups or member accounts of a resource directory
description_zh: 调用TagResources为资源组或资源目录的成员绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager tag-resources --resource-id rg-aekz6bre2uq0000 --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group or the ID of the resource directory member account.

You can specify up to 50 IDs
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID或资源目录成员ID。

最多可以指定50个
parameters.name: resource_id

fields.help_en:
The label key.

The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The label value.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签值。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The labels.

You can attach up to 20 labels
parameters.help_zh:
标签。

最多可以绑定20个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

ResourceGroup (default): attaches labels to resource groups.
Account: attaches labels to member accounts of a resource directory.

This parameter is required when you attach labels to member accounts of a resource directory
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

ResourceGroup（默认值）：为资源组绑定标签。
Account：为资源目录成员绑定标签。

当为资源目录成员绑定标签时，该参数为必选
parameters.name: resource_type
